title: Vectors: keypair derivation
description: Test vectors for keypair derivation. DONE - schnorr48.json
close_reason: Satisfied by test/vectors/x25519.json (3 key_derivation vectors: all-zero seed edge, all-ones seed edge, RFC 8032 §7.1 anchored vector; explicit clamped_scalar/private_key/public_key with bit-level clamping checks) and by schnorr48.json's seed→private_key→public_key fields on all valid vectors. Machine-consumed by python/tests/test_vectors.py::test_x25519_key_derivation_vector (recomputes SHA-512+clamp and Identity.from_seed) and ::test_schnorr_vector (Identity.from_seed feeds sign()). Note: seed→Ed25519-keypair derivation is a total function on 32-byte seeds, so no rejection domain exists; edge cases are the zero/max seeds, both covered. Ran: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_vectors.py -k x25519 -q => 3 passed; -k schnorr => 16 passed.
